newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Several killed when Israel bridge collapses.
newsitem.headline: Several killed when Israel bridge collapses.

text.p: A bridge at an Israeli sports stadium collapsed just before the opening ceremonies of a Jewish sporting event, killing several people and wounding many, Israel television said.
The television said the Australian delegation to the Maccabiah Jewish Games was standing near the bridge when it collapsed. It was not immediately clear what caused the bridge to collapse.

Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was due to attend the opening ceremionies at Ramat Gan Stadium. Israel television broadcast pictures of Netanyahu's security men scrambling amidst ambulances rushed to assist wounded.
It was not immediately clear if Netanyahu was near the area where the bridge collapsed.
